title: HaReCAP: Habitual-action Grounding for Recursive Large Language Model Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.16447v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon embodied tasks require LLM agents to iteratively decompose high-level goals, revise plans in response to environmental feedback, and ground leaf-level subgoals into valid executable actions. Recursive context-management methods such as ReCAP improve planning stability through multi-level task decomposition and parent-node refinement, but still repeatedly invoke the LLM at leaf nodes to ground atomic subtasks into exact valid actions. We refer to this final grounding step as last-mile grounding redundancy, which accumulates into substantial LLM-call and token overhead during long-horizon execution. To mitigate this issue, we propose HaReCAP (Habitual-action Grounded ReCAP), a low-intrusion leaf grounding extension for ReCAP. HaReCAP extracts frequent leaf decisions from successful trajectories and compiles them offline into auditable and abstainable one-step leaf-reflex rules. translated_title: HaReCAP：递归大型语言模型代理的习惯性动作锚定
translated_abstract: 长视界具身任务要求大型语言模型（LLM）代理迭代地分解高层目标，根据环境反馈修订计划，并将叶级子目标锚定为有效的可执行动作。递归上下文管理方法（如ReCAP）通过多级任务分解和父节点细化提高了规划稳定性，但仍需在叶节点反复调用LLM，以将原子子任务锚定为精确的有效动作。我们将这一最终锚定步骤称为“最后一英里锚定冗余”，它在长视界执行过程中累积成大量的LLM调用和令牌开销。为缓解此问题，我们提出HaReCAP（习惯性动作锚定的ReCAP），这是一种低侵入性的ReCAP叶级锚定扩展。HaReCAP从成功的轨迹中提取频繁的叶决策，并离线编译为可审计且可弃权的一步叶反射规则。在运行时，仅在条件满足时跳过叶级LLM调用，从而减少冗余计算，同时保持决策的准确性和可解释性。
tldr: 本文提出HaReCAP，通过离线编译习惯性叶反射规则，在运行时跳过冗余的叶级LLM调用，显著降低长视界任务的令牌和计算开销，而不牺牲决策质量。
en_tdlr: HaReCAP reduces redundant leaf-level LLM calls in long-horizon tasks by compiling habitual leaf reflexes offline, cutting token and computational overhead while maintaining decision quality.
